Title:
AI Animator (Remote)

Company:
IAS | E A S

Job category:
Cinema and Image field

Location:
Tehran

Employment type:
Full-time

Minimum experience:
Three to six years

Salary:
Negotiable

Required skill tags:
- Animator
- Artificial Intelligence
- Ai
- English language

Gender:
Not important

Military service:
Not important

Education:
Not important

Date posted:
2026-06-17

Valid through:
(not available)

Job description:
We are developing an exciting story animation project and are looking for a creative, up-to-date, and specialized colleague who can combine AI video generation tools with high cinematic editing standards. If you love emerging challenges in the world of visuals and can transform AI outputs into a cohesive cinematic work, there is a place for you on our team. Required technical skills: Complete and professional mastery of DaVinci Resolve (Mandatory): Mastery of rhythmic cuts, standard color grading, transitions, and dynamic effects. Proficiency in advanced AI tools (AI Video): Ability to work with video generation and Upscale models, character consistency. Specialist in Image Sound Design: Mastery of sound engineering, arrangement of sound effects (SFX), and precise lip-syncing on characters. Strong English language skills. Personal qualities and work thinking: Deep understanding of atmosphere and genre: Ability to understand the overall project concept and inject creative visual ideas. Obsession with details (Pixel-Perfect): High accuracy in controlling movements, frames, and final output without loss of quality. Responsibility and tight timelines: Committed to delivering projects on time and reliable in deadlines. Interest in daily updates: Someone who tests new AI tools every day and is eager to learn more creative methods.
Requirements and Submission Method: Must have a strong portfolio, samples of work related to animation/music-video, and samples of AI-generated work are our evaluation criteria.

Company description:
"IAS (E A S) operates in the fields of Blockchain and Web 3 and has become a highly productive system by utilizing new technologies and modern management methods, and all employees can collaborate with us on projects remotely."
